name: Send Beta
tagline: Project tactics and training that match your grade
about: Send Beta is a coach for boulderers and sport climbers: it reads your project from a photo, writes training blocks matched to your grade, guides finger and elbow niggles, analyses your grade pyramid and preps trips.
persona: You are a climbing coach who has seen too many finger injuries: technique and tactics before fingerboarding, honest about what a grade needs, and clear that ropes, knots and gear are learned in person, never from an app.

onboarding.title: What are you projecting?
onboarding.subtitle: Grade, discipline and years climbing shape every plan.
bullets: Beta and tactics for your project

tools.title: Read my project
tools.subtitle: Photo → sequence and tactics

inputs.label: Photo of the route or boulder
Grade & where you fall
inputs.placeholder: V5, keep falling going for the top sloper

tools.prompt: Read the route photo for a project described as: {target}, for the profile grade. Sections: steps for a plausible sequence hold by hold (hand, foot, body position), a table (Crux section | Why it's hard | Technique | Rest point), bullets of tactics (warm-up sequence, attempts per session, rest between goes, skipping holds, chalk), and a callout that the beta is a hypothesis to test and on pad, spotter and fall-zone safety.

tools.title: Training block
tools.subtitle: Weeks, days, sets, intensity
tools.prompt: Write a {weeks}-week training block for weakness '{weak}' at {days} days a week for the profile grade and years climbing. Sections: a callout first on whether hangboarding is appropriate at the profile experience and how to load safely, a table (Week | Day | Session | Sets × reps or time | Intensity), bullets on how to tell it's working, and steps for the warm-up used before every session.

tools.title: Finger or elbow niggle
tools.subtitle: What it might be, what to do

inputs.label: What happened
inputs.placeholder: pop on a crimp, swelling at the base of the ring finger

tools.prompt: The climber reports {where} trouble: {what}. Sections: text on the likely category of issue in plain words (not a diagnosis), a table (Sign | Suggests | What to do), steps for the first 72 hours, bullets on what to avoid and how to return to climbing gradually, and a callout on signs (a pop with bowstringing, can't bend the finger, numbness, night pain) that need a clinician or hand specialist now.

tools.title: Grade pyramid
tools.subtitle: Send log → what's missing
tools.prompt: Analyse this send log toward the goal '{goal}': {log}. Sections: kv (pyramid shape, the gap holding the goal back, realistic timeline), a table (Grade | Sends | Needed for a healthy pyramid | Priority), bullets of style biases to fix (slab vs overhang, crimps vs slopers, static vs dynamic), and steps for the next 4 sessions.

tools.title: Trip prep
tools.subtitle: Gear, days, skin, safety
tools.prompt: Prepare a climbing trip to {where} travelling as '{with}' for the profile discipline. Sections: a checklist of gear grouped by category with pad or rope counts, a table (Day | Plan | Rest strategy | Skin care), bullets on local etiquette and conditions, and a callout on safety essentials (guidebook or app, partner checks, emergency numbers, telling someone your plan).

disclaimer: Not medical advice and not a substitute for in-person instruction. Learn belaying, knots, gear placement and falling from a qualified instructor; check every knot and anchor; see a clinician for finger pops, numbness or swelling.
